messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — GPU pool east-1 > 95% utilization for 10m, queue growth detected. autoscaler attempted 2x but hit quota. Pager: P2. links: https://redwood.internal/alerts/2065432100

sre-oncall: Acked. I’m on it. will gather quick metrics and triage.

devon: seeing sustained queue length +4k reqs across primary pool, p50 latency spiking from 120ms -> 1.2s, p95 -> 3.8s. tokens/sec per-gpu down ~30%.

maria: did autoscale kick? what error from the scale controller?

infra-bot: autoscaler@controller: scale attempt #1 -> failed (quota_exceeded: gpu_quota_limit). attempt #2 -> failed (max_retries). rate_limiter engaged.

kevin: confirmed quota_exceeded. east-1 project quota at limit, we've got pending requests queueing. cross-region spillover rules active but backpressure seen on west-2 ingress (429 from routing layer).

maria: is west-2 accepting the model variant? sometimes variant mismatch causes reject.

devon: checking model compatibility — primary serving variant is v2-quant, west-2 has v2-quant and v2-fp16. should be compatible. routing logs show `route_reject: backend_busy` not `variant_mismatch`.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) force manual route split to west-2 for non-SLA customers (low-tier) 2) drain non-critical models 3) open quick request to cloud for emergency quota bump (can take 30-90m).

maria: I’ll open emergency quota now and ping cloud team. kevin, can you start manual split for low-tier traffic? need to avoid impacting premium customers.

kevin: on it. manual route inject for low-tier customers:
```
POST /internal/routing/split HTTP/1.1
Host: controlplane.internal
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "from": "east-1-primary",
  "to": "west-2-primary",
  "selector": {"customer_tier": "low"},
  "weight": 0.9
}
```

infra-bot: route change applied. new ruleset id=rs-9987. starting traffic migration.

devon: observing immediate drop in east-1 queue from 4k -> 2.3k over 3m. p95 latency improving slightly. however, west-2 is returning sporadic 503s for a subset of requests (approx 0.7% of routed). collecting sample request ids.

maria: can we identify commonality for 503s? same model? same customer?

devon: samples show errors mostly for requests that require long context windows (>2048 tokens) — west-2 flavors are configured with lower max-seqlen on v2-quant. looks like fallback failed causing 503.

sre-oncall: ok that explains it — we need targeted routing: only route short-context requests. kevin, revert the global split and apply a finer selector on request sequence-length.

kevin: applying updated selector: {customer_tier: low, max_input_tokens: "<=2048"}. pushing now.

infra-bot: updated ruleset id=rs-9988. migration resumed.

devon: after selector change, west-2 503s dropped to 0.05%. east-1 queue at 1.1k and falling. p95 latency back near baseline for premium.

maria: cloud team replied — emergency quota approved for +8 GPUs in east-1 but provisioning ETA ~22m. will hold additional route changes until provisioned to avoid oscillation.

sre-oncall: good. begin gradual rollback of manual routing for any customers that were incorrectly routed (we have list). devon — please compile list and CS notify doc.

devon: compiled list of affected request ids and customers, saved at https://redwood.internal/incidents/2065432100/artifacts. sending to cs-rep.

cs-rep: thanks — will draft customer comms for the small subset who saw 5xx and extended latency. estimated impacted customers ~12 (non-SLAs), none enterprise.

kevin: provisioning event started: cluster east-1 adding 8 gpus. logs:
```
[12:48:22] k8s: nodepool-scale start -> requested 8 gpus
[12:54:01] cloud: allocation_confirmed -> preparing instances (id: i-0a1b2c3d)
[13:08:31] nodes ready -> attach to pool -> runtime warmup
```

infra-bot: new nodes integrated and ready. autoscaler re-evaluating.

sre-oncall: autoscaler resumed and backfilled queue, east-1 queue drained to normal within 6m. throttling counters reset.

devon: metrics look stable. no additional error spikes. cross-region spillover behaved as designed once selector adjusted.

maria: post-incident actions: 1) increase east-1 quota guardrails for burst by +10 GPUs (ops ticket created) 2) add routing rule tests for max-seqlen compatibility 3) add autoscaler alert to trigger earlier (when >85% for 5m) 4) update runbook with manual selector snippet.

sre-oncall: I’ll produce a short handoff to next oncall. primary takeaways: autoscale failed due to quota (cloud), manual spillover helped but needed selector refinement for seq-len, emergency quota fixed it. no major customer SLA breaches.

ops-handoff: Handoff summary -> Incident 2065432100: east-1 GPU saturation during traffic surge at ~12:40. Manual low-tier routing to west-2 reduced pressure but exposed seq-len variant mismatch (fixed by selector). Emergency quota granted and nodes active ~13:08; cluster healthy by 13:15. Action items assigned to infra and devex. Next oncall please monitor east-1 for 24h for any regression.

sre-oncall: Marking incident as mitigated. will start postmortem doc and schedule blameless incident review. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident 2065432100 status -> mitigated. Summary: capacity-exhaustion -> autoscale blocked by quota -> manual routing (selector fix) -> emergency quota -> recover. Timeline and artifacts: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2065432100/postmortem

ops-handoff: taking next shift notes. cc: @devon @maria @kevin @cs-rep

sre-oncall: thanks team. closing thread after postmortem created.
